title: YesSql Indexes: Query Your Own Documents | Orchard Core
description:
Orchard Core stores most of its data as JSON documents, and SQL cannot query inside a JSON document efficiently. To query your own documents, you write a YesSql index.

This video defines a map index for a product content part, registers its provider, creates its table with a data migration, and queries it through ISession. It also covers a reduce index, the index tables in the database, and the declarations that tell YesSql what an index holds.

In this video:
• Documents and indexes
• A map index
• Register and create the table
• Query your documents
• A reduce index
• See the tables
• Declare the records
